what_to_do.en: Tap the soft g or soft c word.
what_to_do.ko: 부드러운 g 또는 부드러운 c 단어를 누르세요.

stages.choice_rule: Four unique whole-word choices. Exactly one is correct: the soft c or soft g word that names the media lemma. Soft c is c before e, i, or y. Soft g is g before e, i, or y, including ge and dge. Never count get, getting, give, given, girl, girls, gift, geese, begin, or together as soft g. Tier 1 has one soft word and unrelated distractors. Tier 2 has one soft word and same-topic distractors. Tier 3 has a second soft word for a different picture plus hard c or hard g lookalikes. No isolated sounds and no fake spellings. The media lemma equals the correct choice.

Pick the soft g word at school.

roots: Use four unique whole-word choices and exactly one correct tap.
The correct word is soft c or soft g and names the picture lemma.
Soft c is the letter c before e, i, or y. Soft g is the letter g before e, i, or y, including ge and dge.
Never count get, getting, give, given, girl, girls, gift, geese, begin, or together as soft g.
Distractors are real words and do not name the picture. No fake spellings and no isolated sounds.
Tier 1 distractors are unrelated. Tier 2 distractors share a school, home, food, pet, or play topic. Tier 3 adds one wrong-picture soft word and hard c or hard g lookalikes.
Do not write the answer in the stem or describe the picture. The picture is only a media lemma.
Stems may use only the roots word list, allowed extra words, and <NAME>. Never use a real name.

tier_rules.1: Stems of three or four words, such as Pick one word. Use a familiar soft c or soft g picture. Distractors are unrelated and easy to reject.
tier_rules.2: Stems of five to seven words that name soft c or soft g. Only one choice uses that soft spelling. Distractors share a school, home, food, pet, or play topic.
tier_rules.3: Stems of eight to ten words. Add one soft c or soft g word for a different picture, plus hard c or hard g lookalikes, such as cereal beside city or gum beside gym.
